record_title: Strictly convex bodies admit no exponential Riesz bases
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Requires dimension n>=2 and strict convexity of the closed body; it does not subsume the C^2-convex theorem for bodies with flat pieces. The result is qualitative and does not classify general nonsmooth convex bodies with boundary segments. Standard convex-geometry facts and Ortega-Cerdà's boundary criterion are not claimed as new. The relevant source preprints are very recent, so contemporaneous unindexed coverage remains a residual risk. No independent validation is asserted.
